output.reason: The evidence shows that the loan agreement provides for a pre-payment charge of 2% or 3% of principal outstanding in the event of foreclosure or pre-payment (in full or in part). It also shows that, for a Tier 3 UCB, the UCB Responsible Business Conduct Directions (para 261(2)(ii)) prohibit levying any pre-payment charges on floating-rate business-purpose loans to individuals and Micro/Small Enterprises with sanctioned amount/limit up to ₹50 lakh. The evidence further states the case parameters match this prohibition (Tier 3 UCB, floating rate, business purpose, borrower is MSE, sanctioned date on/after Jan 1, 2026, and amount ₹4,000,000 which is ≤ ₹50 lakh). Therefore, the applicable direction does not permit levying the 2% or 3% charge in this case.
